row.title: OPEN-STANDARDS-1: standards replace homegrown formats; schemas over formats
row.body: Rowan asked why YAML/JSON/TOML aren't unified and to apply open standards everywhere. Decision: keep JSON as the machine-written container and standardize the schema (JSON Schema 2020-12) matched by a SchemaStore-format catalog, so one schema validates JSON, YAML and TOML copies. Events: CloudEvents 1.0. Provenance: W3C PROV export. Service catalog: Backstage catalog-info generated from topology. Remaining standards are Q-STD items closed by openstd --probe.
